title: H-XFERROSTER-1: a pool owner (the host) hires one of its OWN candidates pointed at the partner's (the client's) shop and the move reaches the client before the host's next pool publish (holdpub) - the client replaces its company-candidate copy with the real record (ADOPTED into its shop), no candidate-drop for that id, the shop's roster republishes with the new hire, and the host ends up holding the client's copy at that shop; ends dissolved
preconditions: Fixture save1 + in-run merge as T-P4B-PEOPLE-A. Dev build with the levers `hire` and `candidates holdpub` (BAMP_DEV). ROLES MIRRORED from the brief: save1's Client1 has no candidate pool (run T-XFERROSTER-20260927-200852, step 14 'OK 0 candidate(s) from Client1'), so the pool owner is the host and the copy holder / adopter is the client - the same adopt code path (ApplyOnOwner 'adopt' on the machine that holds the company copy). PREMISE: the host has at least one unclaimed candidate that the client holds as a company copy - step 14 FAILING with 'OK 0 candidate(s)' = SKIP (premise not met), not a defect. The hired candidate stays at the client's shop (a mutation of the rig save root only). Candidate counts are reported, not asserted.

the client's own real record at its shop
